B.text: If the bold percentage annotations attached above each source bar are the operative reported production-share values, the source with the greatest printed percentage is the largest contribution source; the routing criterion requires escalating that source.
B.conditions: Applies if attached percentage annotations are authoritative despite disagreement with bar heights.
